name: fatigue: the study on the flange — bottom face fixed, top face loaded; the new curve, loading and method groups are there
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.ensureKernel(); await m.actions.openSampleAsk('flange'); await sleep(1200); await m.run('simulation'); await sleep(300); m.actions.pmSet('study', 'fatigue'); await sleep(200); const e = m.state.editing; const faces = m.state.partEntry.faces; const z = (fc) => { const c = fc.center; return c?.z ?? c?.[2] ?? 0; }; const planar = faces.map((fc, i) => ({ i, fc })).filter((x) => x.fc.geomType === 'PLANE').sort((a, b) => z(a.fc) - z(b.fc)); const pick = (index) => m.viewport.options.onPick({ kind: 'face', bodyKey: 'body', index }, {}); e.pick = 'fixtures'; pick(planar[0].i); e.pick = 'loads'; pick(planar.at(-1).i); e.loadKind = 'force'; e.dir = '-z'; e.magnitude = 300000; m.actions.pmSet('loadKind', 'force'); await sleep(200); const pm = document.querySelector('.left-pm-body'); return JSON.stringify({ study: e.study, groups: ['fatSource', 'fatMode', 'fatMeasure', 'fatMean'].every((k) => pm.querySelector(`[data-pm-set="${k}"]`)), event: Boolean(pm.querySelector('[data-pm-field="fatEv:0:cycles"]')), fixed: e.fixtures.map((x) => x.type).join(), loaded: e.loads.map((x) => x.type).join() }); })()

name: fatigue: two events (10⁴ reversed, 10⁵ zero-based ×1.5), Gerber; the results list life, blocks, damage, load factor of safety, biaxiality
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const field = (k, v) => { const i = q(`[data-pm-field="${k}"]`); i.value = String(v); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; field('fatEv:0:cycles', '10000'); await sleep(150); q('[data-pm="fat.addEvent"]').click(); await sleep(150); field('fatEv:1:cycles', '100000'); await sleep(100); field('fatEv:1:min', '0'); await sleep(100); field('fatEv:1:max', '1.5'); await sleep(100); q('[data-pm-set="fatMean"][data-value="gerber"]').click(); await sleep(150); const e = m.state.editing; await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); for (let i = 0; i < 300 && !e.result?.fat; i++) await sleep(200); const f = e.result?.fat; const text = q('.left-pm-body').textContent; return JSON.stringify({ events: e.fat.events.map((x) => [x.cycles, x.min, x.max]), mean: f?.mean, blockCycles: f?.blockCycles, damage: f?.maxDamage > 0, fos: Number.isFinite(f?.factorOfSafety), tensor: Boolean(e.result?.stat?.vertexTensor), shown: /Load factor of safety|하중 안전율/.test(text) && /Biaxiality|2축성/.test(text) && /blocks|블록/.test(text) }); })()

name: fatigue: the plot switches between damage, life and biaxiality without running again
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const c0 = Array.from(m.state.sim.colors.slice(0, 30)).join(); document.querySelector('[data-pm-set="fatPlot"][data-value="biaxiality"]').click(); await sleep(200); const c1 = Array.from(m.state.sim.colors.slice(0, 30)).join(); const kept = Boolean(m.state.editing.result?.fat); document.querySelector('[data-pm-set="fatPlot"][data-value="life"]').click(); await sleep(200); return JSON.stringify({ changed: c0 !== c1, kept, plot: m.state.editing.fat.plot }); })()

name: fatigue: a load history counted by rainflow (×1000 repeats) and a user S-N table run too
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const field = (k, v) => { const i = q(`[data-pm-field="${k}"]`); i.value = String(v); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; q('[data-pm-set="fatMode"][data-value="history"]').click(); await sleep(150); field('fatHistory', '0, 1, -0.5, 0.8, -1, 0.6, 0'); await sleep(100); field('fatRepeats', '1000'); await sleep(100); q('[data-pm-set="fatSource"][data-value="table"]').click(); await sleep(150); field('fatTable', '1e3:300, 1e5:150, 1e7:80'); await sleep(100); const e = m.state.editing; await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); for (let i = 0; i < 300 && !e.result?.fat; i++) await sleep(200); const f = e.result?.fat; m.actions.cancelEditing({ quiet: true }); return JSON.stringify({ source: f?.curve.source, points: f?.curve.points.length, perBlock: f?.blockCycles / 1000, life: f && f.minLife > 0 }); })()
